Overview
  • Start page with search, favorites, to-do, notes, weather, news.

Shortcuts
  • Ctrl/Cmd+K: open command palette
  • 1-9: open first 9 favorites (when not typing)
  • /: focus search (also via palette)
  • Enter in search: start search
  • ESC: close modals
  • Palette: quick actions for widgets, theme, background, data, favorites
  • Palette: key C switches card style, "Reset header colors" resets search & clock
Search & Autocomplete
  • Bangs:!g!ddg!bing!yt!wiki!maps
  • Custom shortcuts: JSON in settings; {q} as placeholder
  • Autocomplete: bangs, shortcuts, recent searches, wordlist (global + preset)
  • Tab accepts suggestion, Enter starts search
Tiles
  • Drag & drop to sort, click to open
  • + Tile: add a new favorite
  • Reset: restore default favorites
Widgets & Layout
  • Visibility per widget
  • Card style is global (glass, solid, transparent, soft minimal)
  • Custom colors for clock/search; reset restores style defaults
  • Widget colors & "Tint widgets" set the accent per card
Background
  • Presets, uploads, collections, rotation (time/theme/interval)
  • Accent color is extracted from the active background
Data
  • Export/Import as JSON
  • Load data presets (assets/presets/*.json in the repo)
Startpage Agent
  • Integrated AI chat with local Ollama (host/model in settings).
  • Supports streaming responses, stop (button/ESC), persistent history, and Markdown.
  • Agentic tools can read/change widgets and settings (depending on confirm mode).
. This keeps behavior understandable at a glance.
